# Targeting

Start with the target selectors and targets encoded by the offered options. The engine determines legality, visibility, reach, cover, and the concrete target selected by a semantic selector.

For multiple monsters, submit one internally consistent set of choices for every required actor. Compare only state the engine exposes, such as current targets, visible threats, concentration, reach, and movement cost. Do not invent exact damage, assume an uncertain defeat, or convert a self- or ally-targeted utility option into hostile offense.

Use focused target, visibility, cover, and reach queries when the offered summary does not establish legality.
